name: file-watch
description: Watch files/dirs for created/deleted/modified events, emitted as JSON lines on stdout. Polling-based — no inotify dependency. --once makes it a blocking 'wait until file appears/changes' primitive; --timeout bounds the wait.
use_when: waiting for a build artifact, reacting to file changes, gating on a lockfile

args.name: --once
args.description: Print the first event batch and exit 0.

args.name: --timeout S
args.description: Stop after S seconds (default 0 = until SIGTERM).

stdout: One JSON object per event line: {event, path, ts}.
notes: Pair with 'proc' to run in background, or call --once inline as a blocking gate.
